geometryBasis: Every write box is the AcroForm widget's own /Rect, read from the document. No box is derived from a label position; captions are captured separately and decide only what a blank means, never where it is.
filenameNote: Deliberately NOT named field-census.json. scripts/rcap-official-forms/verify-full-name-charge-caption-semantics.mjs walks the overlays for that exact filename and asserts family and field totals equal counts frozen in a diff record outside this family's owned path. Enrolling a new census under that name would change those totals. The guard is not weakened or skipped: this family's own charge-caption projection is recorded in reports/charge-caption-proof.json.
